pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.seo.descripti: Track your daily fasts and Taraweeh, set a Quran khatm goal, and log your Zakat and charity for Ramadan.
pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.title: Ramadan Planner
pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.paragraph: Check off each day's fast and Taraweeh, track your Qur'an reading toward a full khatm, and keep a simple Zakat and charity log.
pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.notRamadanYet: Ramadan hasn't started yet — set up your goals below whenever you like.
pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.dateUnavailab: Couldn't check today's Hijri date — you can still plan manually below.
pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.zakatExplaine: Zakat al-Mal is 2.5% of your zakatable wealth (savings, gold, and business assets held for a full lunar year above the nisab threshold). Enter the total to see what's due — check with a scholar if you're unsure what counts.
pages.tools.RamadanPlanner.charityEmpty: No entries yet — log a donation whenever you give one.
